title: E0089: Log injection
plain_english: Writing user input to log files without sanitizing newline characters (CRLF) can allow an attacker to inject fake log entries or corrupt log data.
why_matters: Log injection can be used to: - Hide attacks by injecting fake log entries - Forge audit trails for social engineering - Corrupt log files, making incident response harder
what_it_checks: `error_log()`, `syslog()`, and `trigger_error()` with tainted superglobals directly interpolated
Custom log writers (`file_put_contents($log, $user_input)`) with user input
